hook_line: ANOTHER TANKER HIT IN THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ

hook_stat.sub: Strait of Hormuz traffic about 65% below pre-conflict levels

stats.label: Vessel transits in the seven days to November 18, down from 308 a week earlier
Incidents recorded by UKMTO in the strait since February 28

diaspora_bullets: The casualties this week included Indian seafarers
One crew member missing and two injured on an LPG tanker attacked on November 16
news_summary: A tanker sailing outbound through the Strait of Hormuz was hit on its stern by an unidentified projectile about 11 nautical miles north of Khasab, UKMTO said, with no injuries reported.
payoff: Oil flows through the strait fell to about 10 million barrels a day by November 10, down from 13.4 million at the start of the month.
